thread.title: Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) Shares Sold by Kessler Investment Group LLC

author: Nicole Wilson
title: Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) Shares Sold by Kessler Investment Group LLC
text:
Posted by Nicole Wilson on Apr 16th, 2018 // No Comments 
Kessler Investment Group LLC lessened its holdings in Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 25.7% during the fourth quarter, according to its most recent 13F filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission. The fund owned 42,946 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 14,855 shares during the period. Apple makes up approximately 9.1% of Kessler Investment Group LLC’s portfolio, making the stock its biggest holding. Kessler Investment Group LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $7,268,000 at the end of the most recent quarter. 
Several other hedge funds and other institutional investors have also made changes to their positions in AAPL. Beach Investment Management LLC. lifted its stake in Apple by 1,517.7% in the second quarter. Beach Investment Management LLC. now owns 178,109 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $25,651,000 after purchasing an additional 167,099 shares during the last quarter. Ruggie Capital Group lifted its stake in Apple by 6.0% in the second quarter. Ruggie Capital Group now owns 4,681 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $675,000 after purchasing an additional 265 shares during the last quarter. Wetherby Asset Management Inc. lifted its stake in Apple by 5.1% in the second quarter. Wetherby Asset Management Inc. now owns 155,377 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $22,377,000 after purchasing an additional 7,475 shares during the last quarter. Carnick & Kubik Group LLC lifted its stake in Apple by 14.4% in the second quarter. Carnick & Kubik Group LLC now owns 20,744 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $2,987,000 after purchasing an additional 2,612 shares during the last quarter. Finally, Sigma Investment Counselors Inc. lifted its stake in Apple by 0.9% in the second quarter. Sigma Investment Counselors Inc. now owns 47,499 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $6,841,000 after purchasing an additional 419 shares during the last quarter. Hedge funds and other institutional investors own 61.35% of the company’s stock. 
In related news, SVP Daniel J. Riccio sold 17,375 shares of the stock in a transaction on Wednesday, April 4th. The stock was sold at an average price of $169.12, for a total value of $2,938,460.00. Following the transaction, the senior vice president now owns 66,191 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $11,194,221.92. The transaction was disclosed in a legal filing with the SEC, which can be accessed through this hyperlink . Also, insider Philip W. Schiller sold 69,491 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction dated Tuesday, April 3rd. The shares were sold at an average price of $166.42, for a total value of $11,564,692.22. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . 0.06% of the stock is owned by corporate insiders. 
Several equities analysts recently commented on the company. Nomura set a $175.00 price objective on Apple and gave the company a “neutral” rating in a research note on Tuesday, April 3rd. Vetr downgraded Apple from a “strong-buy” rating to a “buy” rating and set a $186.86 price objective on the stock. in a research note on Monday, April 2nd. Zacks Investment Research downgraded Apple from a “hold” rating to a “sell” rating in a research note on Wednesday, April 11th. Royal Bank of Canada set a $203.00 price objective on Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research note on Tuesday, April 3rd. Finally, BMO Capital Markets downgraded Apple from an “outperform” rating to a “market perform” rating and increased their target price for the stock from $162.00 to $166.00 in a research report on Wednesday, January 31st. Two equities research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have assigned a hold rating, thirty-two have issued a buy rating and one has issued a strong buy rating to the stock. The company presently has an average rating of “Buy” and an average price target of $203.21. 
AAPL traded up $1.09 during trading on Monday, reaching $175.82. The stock had a trading volume of 21,563,928 shares, compared to its average volume of 36,323,715. The stock has a market cap of $886,582.31, a PE ratio of 19.09, a P/E/G ratio of 1.32 and a beta of 1.25. The company has a quick ratio of 1.20, a current ratio of 1.24 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74. Apple has a one year low of $140.45 and a one year high of $183.50. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 EPS for the quarter, beating the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. The business had revenue of $88.29 billion for the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $87.62 billion. Apple had a return on equity of 37.37% and a net margin of 21.13%. The firm’s revenue was up 12.7% on a year-over-year basis. During the same quarter in the prior year, the firm earned $3.36 earnings per share. equities analysts anticipate that Apple will post 11.37 earnings per share for the current year.
